target_ko: 물리적 M0 surface가 있는지 요구하지 않고, 고정된 virtual AABB reference의 rasterized camera ray endpoint 앞에 관측된 다른 instance가 있는지의 조건부 external-ray proxy를 만든다. 사람의 영상 cue D/E/S나 visible corner truth가 아니다.

source_scope.split_rule: Existing source scenes0..7 TRAIN and8..9 VAL. Preserve all instances/8slots including unknown. No current223 and no GT-best query/detection selection.

reference_geometry.units: millimeters, matching cam_t_m2c; R is dimensionless
reference_geometry.formula: X_fixed = min_xyz + (FIXED_ZUP_SIGNS+1)/2 * size_xyz; Xc = X_fixed @ R_m2c.T + t_m2c; r=(K@Xc)/(K@Xc)[2]; dynamic order uses existing frozen normal_facing_permutation; retain perm GT-only once, not twice.
reference_geometry.existing_corpus_limitation: GT_ONLY_TEACHER_CORPUS.npz stores native_GTref8,perm_dynamic_to_fixed8 and camera-Z-positive flags, not numeric cameraZ; numeric z is computable from existing bounds+pose, no PnP.

depth.conversion: depth_Z_mm = raw_uint16 * scene_camera[frame].depth_scale; all1000 currently scale0.1
depth.invalid: raw depth0, missing file, wrong HW, nonfinite/nonpositive K or referenceZ => U; no target-mask-positive override

ownership.join: GTID is instance ordinal in scene_gt[frame], not object_id. All annotated instances of selected1000frames exist locally (4200). Read mask_visib>0 at identical pixel, include target and every other annotated instance.
ownership.representation: Set of positive GTIDs; unique target=OWN, unique distinct GTID=OTHER_ANNOTATED, no GTID=UNASSIGNED, >1 GTID=OVERLAP. Neither missing annotation nor mask0 is evidence of external cause.
ownership.limits: No exported complete first-hit owner image; M4-derived owner is weak pose/depth-raster evidence. Table/background/unannotated occluders remain unassigned. The current official bop19 policy may include missing-depth pixels; depth validity must be tested first.

raster.reference_not_query: r_GT is fixed teacher anchor; never q, nearest visible surface or GT-snapped/recentered query
raster.pixel: p=floor(r+.5); require continuous0<=r_x<W,0<=r_y<H and rounded p inbounds, reference cameraZ>0. Invalid/outframe typed separately and U for ray evidence.
raster.point_ray_approximation: A fractional reference is rasterized once. Endpoint is the same-pixel camera ray at original referenceZ, not a claim of exact subpixel ray casting through the source renderer.

range_contract.reference_endpoint_range_mm: s_ref = z_ref_mm * gamma; retain original norm(Xc) and raster offset as diagnostics, not substitutes
range_contract.observed_range_interval_mm: depth quantization interval Zlo=max(0,(raw-.5)*depth_scale), Zhi=(raw+.5)*depth_scale; slo=Zlo*gamma, shi=Zhi*gamma
range_contract.why_range_not_Z: The same15mm is a distance tolerance. Equivalent Z tolerance varies as15/gamma; a constant15mm Z test is different. The former V74 one-instance Zgap15mm contract is not claimed equivalent.
range_contract.provenance_limit: 15mm is one explicit prospective scale inspired by BOP standard tolerance, not tuned on current/source results and not a validated sensor-noise or pose-error bound. Even with range conversion this virtual-endpoint test is not official rendered-surface visibility. Root must separately freeze/approve a generation protocol; no sweep proposed here.

primary_external_proxy.positive_1: Valid depth + FOREGROUND_BEFORE_ENDPOINT + unique OTHER_ANNOTATED owner + targetM4==0 => EXTERNAL_OTHER_FIRST_HIT_PROXY
primary_external_proxy.negative_0: Valid depth + CLEAR_TO_ENDPOINT_PROXY => CLEAR_TO_VIRTUAL_ENDPOINT_PROXY, even if M0(r)==0
primary_external_proxy.M0_admission: M0 is not loaded into the label decision. Keep M0(r), M4(r), physical-surface diagnostics separate if later audited. No snapping r to M0.
primary_external_proxy.self_separation: OWN foreground is OWN_FIRST_HIT audit, not semantic S and not an external-negative veto. The existing convex-face self_proxy is exported independently. Single-layer depth cannot determine an external obstruction hidden behind a nearer own surface, so this stays U for external target.

legacy_comparison: Existing v60 target is multi-ray aggregate external blockage>=.5, not this single rasterized reference ray. Original occlusion_fraction9 and any nine-probe audits must remain separately named; no silent cross-source label equality or old primary reinterpretation.

forward_boundary.prospective_allowed: Existing RGB/P3/local/target inputs with input-only q/L/box/full predicted q8, deployment logical native slot and context42 may be explicitly versioned. Current model contracts remain unchanged in this review.
forward_boundary.native_identity_caveat: A public deployed slot index does not leak r/state, but public YCB camera-dynamic AABB slots are constructed weak references and are not pallet physical8 semantic gold. A native slot/full-query input needs its own versioned association contract and identifiability audit.

unknowns_before_generation: Actual RGB-depth registration/depth edges and pose calibration not independently checked for all frames.
Historical generation mode/delta of delivered M4 not fully established; invalid depth never becomes clear.
Meshes/target-only depth/complete first-hit owner buffers absent locally.
Virtual AABB corners need not lie on physical mesh/cue; LOS-clear is not visible cue D.
No all4200 source label computation or coverage count yet.
No claim of exact replay of synthetic historical nine-ray raycast or human D/E/S.
